publish.atproto.bridgy: The site address the publication names. To reach Mastodon and the fediverse too, see the guide: Bridgy Fed bridges Standard.site posts, with no server of yours.
publish.atproto.enable: Also publish to my AT Protocol account (Bluesky, Leaflet) as Standard.site documents
publish.atproto.password.hint: An App Password, not your main password (Bluesky: Settings → Privacy and security → App passwords). It is kept in this device's secret store, never in the vault or the logs.
publish.atproto.publishing: Publishing {count} notes to the AT Protocol…
publish.atproto.remove: Remove the picked notes from the AT Protocol
publish.atproto.removed: {count} notes removed from the AT Protocol
publish.atproto.removing: Removing {count} notes from the AT Protocol…
publish.atproto.title: AT Protocol (Standard.site)
publish.done.github: Published {count} pages to {url}. GitHub may take a minute to serve them.
publish.intro: The notes you pick become a website with navigation, search and right-to-left pages. Nothing is sent until you press Publish, and then only to the place you choose.
publish.missing: {count} file(s) the notes reference were not found and stay as links.
publish.target.zip: A .zip file (for Netlify Drop, Cloudflare Pages or any web server)
publish.title: Publish site
publish.token.hint: Kept on this device. Empty: the git sync token is used.
